name: Strategy candidate
about: A strategy candidate from the AI research pipeline; the operator decides whether it is tested
title: "candidate: "
labels: candidate
---

## Idea

One paragraph describing the idea, plus the exact rule (entry, exit, sizing) in plain words.

## Why it might work

The economic or behavioural reason, with citations (the research bundle and its sources are the starting library).

## Evidence so far

Published results, each with an evidence grade (academic / practitioner / marketing).

## Novelty check

Output of `check_novel` against `backtest/tested_cells.py`, and an honest statement of overlap with killed families.

## Data feasibility

Instruments, history length, and data source.

## Proposed test

Grid size N (counts toward the programme trial budget), windows, and costs.

## AI recommendation

Test or do not test, and why.
